notes: Card flags the pole broad (2.5% of tokens reach 0.1 of max, max 2.83) with the gate-closed leak regime at 100%. Top examples: 'sz', 'ő', 'ō', 'ī' in Hungarian / Latvian / romanized names, then many '),' and "']," at ~0.3-0.4 of max. Probes: kő 0.57, rōmaji 0.32, Rīga 0.24, plain Riga 0.05, "']," 0.23. Registered to record the density, not a meaning.
